description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/cartesian_uniform_2d/rules/central_Dxy_neumann_bc (the mixed second derivative d^2u/dx dy with Neumann walls) driven by problems/anisotropic_diffusion_2d_neumann.esm. The problem file is loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding of NX=NY together (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4). The MMS embeds the symmetric-indefinite cross operator in the positive-definite anisotropic diffusion tensor K=[[1,1/2],[1/2,1]]: the combined operator D(D(u,x),x)+D(D(u,x),y)+D(D(u,y),y) (central_D2x_neumann_bc + central_Dxy_neumann_bc + central_D2y_neumann_bc). Per-axis Neumann walls leave a residual conormal boundary flux, so the operator is only conditionally well-posed; the manufactured steady solution cos(pi x) cos(pi y) (zero normal derivative on all walls) makes that boundary term vanish and the dissipative bulk keeps the integration stable, so the drift at t=0.1 is the pure O(h^2) truncation of the anisotropic operator, whose cross-derivative half is the rule under test.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator

blocked_upstream_bindings.rust: Rust hangs at every tolerance tried on this stiff / non-smooth / large-AST anisotropic-diffusion RHS (same failure as anisotropic_diffusion_2d_periodic): earthsci-ast-rs's diffsol integrator has no dtmin/max-step fail-fast guard, so it drives dt->0 without terminating instead of erroring. Julia (Tsit5) and Python (LSODA) solve it. Remove once the Rust solver gains a step guard.
